args.reason: The DoD adds a persisted per-PR history log (.faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl) and an --explain timeline with --since and --format query options. The PRD goal is inspecting the current decision and explicitly puts historical storage and query features outside the PRD. These DoD capabilities are not in the declared goal set, so the PRDR exceeds its PRD. The Phase-1 claim that history is a natural extension of inspection contradicts the stated exclusion.
